name: ldk-github-project-ops
description: Role-based delivery and portfolio operations for GitHub Projects, Issues, and pull requests.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and deliver role-owned work in GitHub Projects.
interface.longDescription: A human-oriented workflow that turns briefs into native GitHub Project items, issues, sub-issues and dependencies; executes one role phase at a time; reviews pull-request evidence; reports lifecycle health; and repairs inconsistent project metadata without a daemon or database.
capabilities: Project status updates and lifecycle reporting
defaultPrompt: Create role-owned work from this product brief.
Perform GitHub issue #123 as its current role.
Report this GitHub Project and its next actions.
